```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "C.UTF-8"))
library(data.table)
library(DT)
# R code here is ASCII only (HTML entities for special characters), so the page renders the same in any locale
A <- "docs/assets/ctwas_scz"
pa <- fread(file.path(A, "params.tsv")); g <- fread(file.path(A, "gene_pips.tsv")); cv <- fread(file.path(A, "convergence.tsv"))
RUNS <- c(cis_reads10nc="Read-based isoLASER", cis_panel10nc="Transcript-based isoLASER",
          cis_reads10nc_pooled="Read-based isoLASER, pooled", cis_panel10nc_pooled="Transcript-based isoLASER, pooled")
SEP <- c("cis_reads10nc", "cis_panel10nc"); POOL <- c("cis_reads10nc_pooled", "cis_panel10nc_pooled")
TPS <- c("0hr", "1hr", "6hr")
tps_of <- function(s) if (s %in% POOL) "pooled" else TPS
combos_of <- function(sets) rbindlist(lapply(sets, function(s) data.table(set=s, tp=tps_of(s))))
tpl <- function(x) fifelse(x == "pooled", "pooled", sub("hr", " hr", x))
short <- function(s) sub(" isoLASER", "", RUNS[s])
lab <- function(s, t) fifelse(t == "pooled", short(s), paste0(short(s), ", ", tpl(t)))
fmt <- function(n) format(n, big.mark=",", trim=TRUE, scientific=FALSE)
fp <- function(x) vapply(x, function(z) if (is.na(z)) "NA" else format(signif(z, 2)), "")
rng <- function(x, d=1) if (min(x) == max(x)) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), min(x)) else sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f&ndash;%.", d, "f"), min(x), max(x))
cell <- function(x) fifelse(is.na(x), "&ndash;", sprintf("%.2f", x))
sp <- pa[group == "splicing"]; sn <- pa[group == "SNP"]
g8_any <- sort(unique(g[gene_pip >= 0.8, gene_name]))
n8 <- function(s) g[set == s & gene_pip >= 0.8, .N]
new8 <- function(base) sort(setdiff(g[set == paste0(base, "_pooled") & gene_pip >= 0.8, gene_name], g[set == base & gene_pip >= 0.8, gene_name]))
pr <- sp[set == "cis_reads10nc_pooled"]; pt <- sp[set == "cis_panel10nc_pooled"]

# the same tables and figures for both kinds of runs
params_table <- function(sets) {
  w <- merge(sp[set %in% sets], sn[, .(set, tp, snp_prior=prior)], by=c("set", "tp"))[order(match(set, sets), match(tp, c(TPS, "pooled")))]
  knitr::kable(w[, .(Run=RUNS[set], Timepoint=tpl(tp), group_size=fmt(group_size),
    `group_prior (splicing)`=sprintf("%.4f", prior), `group_prior (SNP)`=sprintf("%.5f", snp_prior),
    group_prior_var=sprintf("%.1f", prior_var), `log_enrichment (log_enrichment_se)`=sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", log_enrichment, log_enrichment_se),
    enrichment_pval=fp(enrichment_pval), `group_pve (splicing)`=sprintf("%.4f", pve),
    total_pve=sprintf("%.3f", total_pve), `prop_heritability (splicing)`=sprintf("%.4f", prop_heritability))], align="llrrrrrrrrr")
}
pie_tabs <- function(sets, h) for (s in sets) {
  cat(h, " ", short(s), "\n\n", sep="")
  cat("![](assets/ctwas_scz/piechart_", s, ".png)\n\n[Open as PDF](assets/ctwas_scz/piechart_", s, ".pdf)\n\n", sep="")
}
conv_tabs <- function(cmb, h) for (i in seq_len(nrow(cmb))) { s <- cmb$set[i]; t <- cmb$tp[i]
  cat(h, " ", lab(s, t), "\n\n", sep="")
  cat("![](assets/ctwas_scz/convergence_", s, "_", t, ".png)\n\n[Open as PDF](assets/ctwas_scz/convergence_", s, "_", t, ".pdf)\n\n", sep="")
}
conv_line <- function(sets) { d <- cv[set %in% sets]
  sprintf("%s, in %s iterations (of at most 50).", if (all(d$converged)) sprintf("All %d runs converged", nrow(d)) else sprintf("%d of %d runs converged", sum(d$converged), nrow(d)), rng(d$iterations, 0)) }
gene_table <- function(d) {
  d <- d[order(-gene_pip)]
  x <- d[, .(gene_name, combined_pip=sprintf("%.2f", gene_pip), Parts=n_parts,
             `Top part`=top_part, `susie_pip (top part)`=sprintf("%.2f", top_part_pip), z=sprintf("%.1f", z), `QTL (UKB ID)`=ukb_id,
             `&Delta;PSI`=sprintf("%+.3f", dpsi), `Permutation p`=fp(qtl_p))]
  if (all(d$tp == "pooled")) x[, `QTL from` := tpl(d$tp_source)]
  paste(knitr::kable(x, escape=FALSE), collapse="\n")
}
gene_tabs <- function(cmb, h) for (i in seq_len(nrow(cmb))) { s <- cmb$set[i]; t <- cmb$tp[i]
  cat(h, " ", lab(s, t), "\n\n", sep="")
  d <- g[set == s & tp == t & gene_pip >= 0.5]
  if (!nrow(d)) cat("No gene reaches 0.5.\n\n") else cat(gene_table(d), "\n\n", sep="")
}
```

We ran cTWAS on the schizophrenia (SCZ) GWAS with our isoLASER associations as
splicing QTLs. cTWAS asks two things: whether the splicing QTLs explain more
GWAS heritability than SNPs in general (**enrichment**), and which genes'
splicing is likely causal (**PIP**, the posterior inclusion probability). We ran
it for each timepoint separately, and with all timepoints pooled.

**Short answer.**

- **Enrichment:** the splicing QTLs are enriched in every run. The
  `log_enrichment` for separate timepoints is `r rng(sp[set == "cis_reads10nc", log_enrichment])`
  read-based and `r rng(sp[set == "cis_panel10nc", log_enrichment])`
  transcript-based; pooled, it is `r sprintf("%.2f", pr$log_enrichment)` and
  `r sprintf("%.2f", pt$log_enrichment)`.
- **prop_heritability** of the splicing group: small, `r rng(sp$prop_heritability, 4)`,
  because even the largest run has only `r fmt(max(sp$group_size))` traits against millions of SNPs.
- **Genes:** `r length(g8_any)` genes reach a gene-level `combined_pip` of 0.8 in
  at least one run: `r paste(g8_any, collapse=", ")`. LY6H, our GWAS Catalog
  highlight for smoking, reaches 0.8 at every read-based timepoint.
- **Pooling** gives `r fmt(pr$group_size)` read-based and `r fmt(pt$group_size)`
  transcript-based traits, and `r n8("cis_reads10nc_pooled")` and
  `r n8("cis_panel10nc_pooled")` genes at `combined_pip` 0.8. Genes not at 0.8 in
  any single-timepoint run: read-based
  `r if (length(new8("cis_reads10nc"))) paste(new8("cis_reads10nc"), collapse=", ") else "none"`;
  transcript-based `r if (length(new8("cis_panel10nc"))) paste(new8("cis_panel10nc"), collapse=", ") else "none"`.
<!-- - **Caveat:** some top genes rest on parts with no allelic effect (permutation -->
<!--   p near 1), see [Caveats](#caveats). -->

# How the runs were set up

- **GWAS:** PGC schizophrenia, `ieu-b-5102` (N = 127,906), z-scores harmonized to
  the UK Biobank (UKB) LD reference, from the earlier multigroup cTWAS project.
- **Molecular traits** (our definition): one trait per tested exonic part. A part
  is included when one of its associations has isoLASER's `cis` label, computed
  from the panel-heterozygous donors only, with no ΔPSI or FDR cutoff. This is
  the first set of the [GTEx comparison](isolaser_gtex_comparison_reads10nc_q010_hetcis.html).
- **QTL and weight:** each trait has one SNP, the part's `cis` variant with the
  smallest permutation p (ties: largest \|ΔPSI\|), among single-base variants in
  the UKB reference that are not strand-ambiguous. The weight is ΔPSI (ALT minus
  REF inclusion) with ALT as the effect allele. With one SNP per trait, only the
  weight's sign matters.
- **Mapping table:** each trait (exonic part) maps to the gene the part belongs
  to. It is written with the weights and used for gene-level PIPs.
- **Two kinds of runs**, each with a single splicing group: one run per
  timepoint, and one run per version with all timepoints pooled (how the weights
  were pooled is described [there](#all-timepoints-pooled)).
- **Settings:** UKB b38 LD, no thinning, one prior variance shared by all groups
  (`shared_all`), up to 5 signals per region (L = 5), at least 100 traits per
  group. Regions are fine-mapped when their non-SNP PIP is at least 0.5.
- **Not done yet:** merging regions and checking LD mismatch.

## What the tables and figures show

**Parameters**, the output of `summarize_param()`:

- **group_size:** splicing traits that reach cTWAS after matching to the GWAS and the LD reference.
- **group_prior:** the estimated prior probability that a trait (splicing) or a
  variant (SNP) is causal.
- **group_prior_var:** the prior variance of a causal effect, shared by both groups (`shared_all`).
- **log_enrichment:** the log of the splicing prior over the SNP prior, with its
  standard error; **enrichment_pval** is its p-value.
- **group_pve:** the proportion of SCZ variance explained by the group:
  group_size &times; group_prior &times; group_prior_var / GWAS N. **total_pve**
  sums the splicing and SNP groups.
- **prop_heritability:** a group's group_pve over total_pve, the slices of the
  pie charts.

**Convergence**, from `make_convergence_plots()`: the estimates at each iteration
of the parameter estimation. Proportion causal (&pi;) is `group_prior`, effect
size (&sigma;<sup>2</sup>) is `group_prior_var`, enrichment
(&pi;<sub>G</sub>/&pi;<sub>S</sub>, not on the log scale), and PVE. Flat lines
at the end mean the estimates have settled.

**Gene-level PIPs:** `combined_pip` combines a gene's exonic parts with
`combine_gene_pips()` (`method = "combine_cs"`, `filter_cs = FALSE`: all parts,
whether or not they are in a credible set). It sums the parts' `susie_pip`
within each credible set and combines credible sets as
1 &minus; &prod;(1 &minus; sum). Parts that share a top SNP are identical
predictors and split their PIP, so a gene's `combined_pip` can be high when none
of its parts is. The gene tables list genes with `combined_pip` of at least 0.5:

- **Parts:** the gene's parts in fine-mapped regions.
- **Top part:** the part with the largest `susie_pip`, its `susie_pip`, and its z-score (z).
- **QTL:** the top part's SNP. **ΔPSI** and **permutation p** are its isoLASER
  association, from our permutation test. In pooled runs, **QTL from** gives the
  timepoint the QTL was taken from.

## Gene-level PIPs

### Genes with combined_pip of at least 0.8 in any timepoint

```{r sep_overview}
cmb <- combos_of(SEP); keys <- cmb[, paste(set, tp, sep="_")]
o <- dcast(g[set %in% SEP & gene_name %in% g[set %in% SEP & gene_pip >= 0.8, gene_name]], gene_name ~ set + tp, value.var="gene_pip")
for (k in setdiff(keys, names(o))) o[, (k) := NA_real_]
o <- o[order(-do.call(pmax, c(lapply(keys, function(k) o[[k]]), na.rm=TRUE)))]
out <- data.table(gene_name=o$gene_name); for (i in seq_along(keys)) out[, (lab(cmb$set[i], cmb$tp[i])) := cell(o[[keys[i]]])]
knitr::kable(out, escape=FALSE, align=c("l", rep("r", length(keys))))
```

Each cell is the gene's `combined_pip` in that run. "&ndash;" means the gene was
not in a fine-mapped region in that run.

### By run and timepoint {.tabset}

```{r sep_genes, results="asis"}
gene_tabs(combos_of(SEP), "####")
```

# All timepoints pooled

**How the weights were pooled** (our definition): one run per version, with the
traits of all three timepoints in one weight file. Each exonic part enters once,
with the QTL of the timepoint where its association has the smallest permutation
p (ties: largest \|ΔPSI\|, then the earlier timepoint). Keeping a part once per
timepoint would give identical predictors, which split their PIP.

## Parameters

```{r pool_params}
params_table(POOL)
```

## prop_heritability {.tabset}

```{r pool_pies, results="asis"}

```

`r conv_line(POOL)`


## Gene-level PIPs

### Genes with combined_pip of at least 0.8 when pooled

```{r pool_overview}
best <- function(base, gn) vapply(gn, function(x) { v <- g[set == base & gene_name == x, gene_pip]; if (length(v)) max(v) else NA_real_ }, 0)
pool_g <- function(s, gn) vapply(gn, function(x) { v <- g[set == s & gene_name == x, gene_pip]; if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ }, 0)
gn <- sort(unique(g[set %in% POOL & gene_pip >= 0.8, gene_name]))
out <- data.table(gene_name=gn, a=pool_g("cis_reads10nc_pooled", gn), b=best("cis_reads10nc", gn), c=pool_g("cis_panel10nc_pooled", gn), d=best("cis_panel10nc", gn))
out <- out[order(-pmax(a, c, na.rm=TRUE))]
knitr::kable(out[, .(gene_name, `Read-based, pooled`=cell(a), `Read-based, best single timepoint`=cell(b),
                     `Transcript-based, pooled`=cell(c), `Transcript-based, best single timepoint`=cell(d))], escape=FALSE, align="lrrrr")
```

Each cell is the gene's `combined_pip`. **Best single timepoint** is its largest
`combined_pip` over the three separate runs; "&ndash;" means it was not in a
fine-mapped region there.

### By run {.tabset}

```{r pool_genes, results="asis"}
gene_tabs(combos_of(POOL), "####")
```

# All genes

```{r all_genes}
DT::datatable(as.data.frame(g[, .(Run=short(set), Timepoint=tpl(tp), gene_name, combined_pip=round(gene_pip, 3),
  Parts=n_parts, `Top part`=top_part, `susie_pip (top part)`=round(top_part_pip, 3), z=round(z, 2),
  QTL=ukb_id, dPSI=round(dpsi, 3), `Permutation p`=signif(qtl_p, 2), `QTL from`=tpl(tp_source))][order(-combined_pip)]), rownames=FALSE, filter="top",
  extensions="Buttons", options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE, dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("copy", "csv")),
  caption="Every gene in a fine-mapped region, in every run.")
```
